data.desc: Entegris is a leading supplier of critical advanced materials and process solutions for the semiconductor and other high-tech industries. Entegris has approximately 9,000 employees throughout its global operations and is ISO 9001 certified. It has manufacturing, customer service and/or research facilities in the United States , Canada , China , Germany , Israel , Japan , Malaysia , Singapore , South Korea , and Taiwan . Additional information can be found at www.entegris.com .
